definitions.gloss: profit-making; pursuit of profit; commercial gain
definitions.explanation: Refers to the purpose or activity of earning money or making a profit. Commonly used to categorize organizations and activities as profit-oriented or not.

examples.japanese: {営利|えいり}⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Use for commercial purposes is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非営利|ひえいり}→非営利：19298_hieiri⟧⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This organization is registered as a non-profit corporation.

examples.japanese: {営利|えいり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}→社会貢献：22315_shakaikouken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: I want to value social contribution, not just the pursuit of profit.

notes:
Composed of {営|えい} (manage, operate) + ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (profit, benefit). A formal word used mainly in legal, business, and institutional contexts to classify activities or organizations by whether they aim to make a profit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営利|えいり}⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: commercial purpose
- {営利|えいり}⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: for-profit corporation
- ⟦{非営利|ひえいり}→非営利：19298_hieiri⟧: non-profit
- ⟦{非営利|ひえいり}→非営利：19298_hieiri⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: non-profit organization (NPO)
- {営利|えいり}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: profit-making activity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧: profit — the actual money earned; {営利|えいり} is the purpose or pursuit of profit
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧: commerce — broader term for commercial/business activity
- ⟦{収益|しゅうえき}→収益：06302_shuueki⟧: revenue, earnings — focuses on what is actually earned
